page.overview:
Who is Bok Askol?

Bok Askol was a Pacithhip female from Shimia who worked as a podracer engineer. In 32 BBY, Askol was present in Mos Espa spaceport on the planet Tatooine to attend the Boonta Eve Classic podrace. The Pacithhip spent time in the hangar of the Mos Espa Grand Arena before watching the race from the private box of the junk dealer Watto.

Bok Askol was a Pacithhip female born on Shimia Askol was in the spaceport on the planet Tatooine to attend the Boonta Eve Classic podrace

Prior to the race, the Pacithhip spent time in the podracer hangar Askol then viewed the race itself from the private box of the Toydarian junk dealer Watto in the arena.

During the First Order occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, Askol was 90 years old. At this time, the pirate Hondo Ohnaka sent several stolen identity profiles, including a profile of Askol, to the datapads of several individuals in Black Spire Outpost on Batuu. The individuals were preparing to carry out a heist for Ohnaka Transport Solutions, and Ohnaka wished to test if they could remember information concerning a potential cover identity, quizzing them on details from each of the profiles.
